display_text: Attuned to Heroism ** [[Attuned to Heroism|Attuned by Heroism: Tier 1]] *** [[Armor Bonus|Armor Bonus +10]][[Armor Bonus|Armor Bonus +10]]: This item surrounds the wearer with an invisible but tangible field of force, granting +10 armor bonus to AC, just as though he were wearing armor.[[Category: Armor Bonus 10 items]] → [[Armor Bonus|Armor Bonus +11]][[Armor Bonus|Armor Bonus +11]]: This item surrounds the wearer with an invisible but tangible field of force, granting +11 armor bonus to AC, just as though he were wearing armor.[[Category: Armor Bonus 11 items]] ** [[Attuned to Heroism | Attuned by Heroism: Tier 2]] *** [[Protection|Protection +7]][[Protection|Protection +7]]: Passive: +7 [[Deflection bonus]] to [[Armor Class]].[[Category:Protection +7 items]] → [[Protection|Protection +8]][[Protection|Protection +8]]: Passive: +8 [[Deflection bonus]] to [[Armor Class]].[[Category:Protection +8 items]] *** [[Shield Bonus|Shield +6]][[Shield Bonus|Shield +6]]: While this item is equipped, you are partially protected by a field of magical force which can deflect enemy attacks. This item provides a +6 Shield bonus to Armor Class. It does not stack with an equipped shield.[[Category: Shield +6 items]] → [[Shield Bonus|Shield +8]][[Shield Bonus|Shield +8]]: While this item is equipped, you are partially protected by a field of magical force which can deflect enemy attacks. This item provides a +8 Shield bonus to Armor Class. It does not stack with an equipped shield.[[Category: Shield +8 items]] [[Category:Attuned to Heroism items]]
